ayahs.en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

ayahs.tj: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ٣
ayahs.en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].

ayahs.tj: وَلَلْأَخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ٤
ayahs.en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

ayahs.tj: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔـاوَىٰ ٦
ayahs.en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
And He found you lost and guided [you],
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

ayahs.tj: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ ٩
ayahs.en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

ayahs.tj: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ ١٠
ayahs.en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

ayahs.tj: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ ١١
ayahs.en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
